targets.rawSql: WITH k AS ( SELECT close_time, (2 * taker_buy_base_volume - volume)::double precision AS net_taker_flow FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' ), i AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inventory, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inventory FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), joined AS ( SELECT k.close_time, k.net_taker_flow, COALESCE(i.inventory - i.prev_inventory, 0) AS inventory_delta FROM k LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT collected_at, inventory, prev_inventory FROM i WHERE collected_at <= k.close_time ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) i ON TRUE ) SELECT close_time AS time, net_taker_flow, inventory_delta, (net_taker_flow - inventory_delta) AS flow_inventory_divergence FROM joined WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time

SELECT collected_at AS time, available_inventory::double precision AS inventory FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

WITH inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), changes AS ( SELECT collected_at, -GREATEST(0, prev_inv - inv) AS borrow_proxy, GREATEST(0, inv - prev_inv) AS repay_proxy FROM inv WHERE prev_inv IS NOT NULL ), bucketed AS ( SELECT time_bucket('${inv_interval}', collected_at) AS time, SUM(borrow_proxy) AS borrow_proxy, SUM(repay_proxy) AS repay_proxy FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(ABS(borrow_proxy)),0), COALESCE(MAX(repay_proxy),0)) * 1.3 AS mx FROM bucketed ), padding AS ( SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, -mx AS borrow_proxy, mx AS repay_proxy FROM bounds ) SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM bucketed UNION ALL SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM padding ORDER BY time

WITH ratios AS ( SELECT close_time, CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END AS ratio, LAG( CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END ) OVER (ORDER BY close_time) AS prev_ratio FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' ) SELECT close_time AS time, CASE WHEN prev_ratio > 0 AND ratio > 0 THEN LN(ratio / prev_ratio) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS buy_sell_log_change FROM ratios WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time

WITH ratios AS ( SELECT close_time, CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END AS ratio, LAG( CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END ) OVER (ORDER BY close_time) AS prev_ratio FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' ) SELECT close_time AS time, CASE WHEN prev_ratio > 0 AND ratio > 0 THEN LN(ratio / prev_ratio) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS buy_sell_log_change FROM ratios WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time

WITH inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), changes AS ( SELECT collected_at, -GREATEST(0, prev_inv - inv) AS borrow_proxy, GREATEST(0, inv - prev_inv) AS repay_proxy FROM inv WHERE prev_inv IS NOT NULL ), bucketed AS ( SELECT time_bucket('${inv_interval}', collected_at) AS time, SUM(borrow_proxy) AS borrow_proxy, SUM(repay_proxy) AS repay_proxy FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(ABS(borrow_proxy)),0), COALESCE(MAX(repay_proxy),0)) * 1.3 AS mx FROM bucketed ), padding AS ( SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, -mx AS borrow_proxy, mx AS repay_proxy FROM bounds ) SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM bucketed UNION ALL SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM padding ORDER BY time

SELECT collected_at AS time, available_inventory::double precision AS base_inventory FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT collected_at AS time, available_inventory::double precision AS quote_inventory FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

WITH base_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, FIRST_VALUE(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS first_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ), base_pct AS ( SELECT collected_at AS time, (inv - first_inv) / NULLIF(first_inv, 0) * 100 AS base_inventory_pct FROM base_inv ), quote_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, FIRST_VALUE(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS first_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ), quote_pct AS ( SELECT collected_at AS time, (inv - first_inv) / NULLIF(first_inv, 0) * 100 AS quote_inventory_pct FROM quote_inv ) SELECT COALESCE(b.time, q.time) AS time, b.base_inventory_pct, q.quote_inventory_pct FROM base_pct b FULL OUTER JOIN quote_pct q ON b.time = q.time ORDER BY 1

WITH inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), changes AS ( SELECT collected_at, -GREATEST(0, prev_inv - inv) AS borrow, GREATEST(0, inv - prev_inv) AS repay FROM inv WHERE prev_inv IS NOT NULL ), bucketed AS ( SELECT time_bucket('${inv_interval}', collected_at) AS time, SUM(borrow) AS base_borrow, SUM(repay) AS base_repay FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(ABS(base_borrow)),0), COALESCE(MAX(base_repay),0)) * 1.3 AS mx FROM bucketed ), padding AS ( SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, -mx AS base_borrow, mx AS base_repay FROM bounds ) SELECT time, base_borrow, base_repay FROM bucketed UNION ALL SELECT time, base_borrow, base_repay FROM padding ORDER BY time

WITH inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' ), changes AS ( SELECT collected_at, -GREATEST(0, prev_inv - inv) AS borrow, GREATEST(0, inv - prev_inv) AS repay FROM inv WHERE prev_inv IS NOT NULL ), bucketed AS ( SELECT time_bucket('${inv_interval}', collected_at) AS time, SUM(borrow) AS quote_borrow, SUM(repay) AS quote_repay FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(ABS(quote_borrow)),0), COALESCE(MAX(quote_repay),0)) * 1.3 AS mx FROM bucketed ), padding AS ( SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, -mx AS quote_borrow, mx AS quote_repay FROM bounds ) SELECT time, quote_borrow, quote_repay FROM bucketed UNION ALL SELECT time, quote_borrow, quote_repay FROM padding ORDER BY time

WITH totals AS ( SELECT k.close_time, SUM(k.quote_volume::double precision) AS total_qv FROM spot_klines k INNER JOIN margin_pairs mp ON k.symbol = mp.symbol AND mp.is_margin_trade = TRUE AND mp.quote_asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' WHERE $__timeFilter(k.close_time) GROUP BY k.close_time ), raw AS ( SELECT a.close_time, CASE WHEN t.total_qv > 0 THEN (a.quote_volume::double precision / t.total_qv * 100)::double precision ELSE NULL END AS dominance_pct FROM spot_klines a LEFT JOIN totals t ON a.close_time = t.close_time WHERE a.symbol = '${symbol:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(a.close_time) ) SELECT close_time AS time, dominance_pct, AVG(dominance_pct) OVER (ORDER BY close_time ROWS BETWEEN 23 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_dominance_pct FROM raw ORDER BY close_time

WITH base_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), quote_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' ), combined AS ( SELECT b.collected_at, b.inv AS b_inv, q.inv AS q_inv, AVG(b.inv) OVER w AS b_mean, NULLIF(STDDEV(b.inv) OVER w, 0) AS b_std, AVG(q.inv) OVER w AS q_mean, NULLIF(STDDEV(q.inv) OVER w, 0) AS q_std FROM base_inv b JOIN quote_inv q ON b.collected_at = q.collected_at WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY b.collected_at ROWS BETWEEN 287 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ) SELECT collected_at AS time, COALESCE(-(q_inv - q_mean) / q_std, 0) - COALESCE(-(b_inv - b_mean) / b_std, 0) AS directional_stress FROM combined WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

targets.rawSql: WITH flows AS ( SELECT close_time, (2 * taker_buy_base_volume - volume)::double precision AS net_flow FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' AND close_time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND close_time <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz ), stats AS ( SELECT close_time, net_flow, AVG(net_flow) OVER w AS rolling_mean, NULLIF(STDDEV(net_flow) OVER w, 0) AS rolling_std FROM flows WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY close_time ROWS BETWEEN 287 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ) SELECT close_time AS time, COALESCE((net_flow - rolling_mean) / rolling_std, 0) AS net_flow_zscore FROM stats WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time

WITH vol AS ( SELECT close_time, volume::double precision AS total_vol, taker_buy_base_volume::double precision AS buy_vol, GREATEST(0, (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision AS sell_vol FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' AND close_time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND close_time <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz ), stats AS ( SELECT close_time, total_vol, buy_vol, sell_vol, AVG(total_vol) OVER w AS avg_vol, NULLIF(STDDEV(total_vol) OVER w, 0) AS std_vol, AVG(buy_vol) OVER w AS avg_buy, NULLIF(STDDEV(buy_vol) OVER w, 0) AS std_buy, AVG(sell_vol) OVER w AS avg_sell, NULLIF(STDDEV(sell_vol) OVER w, 0) AS std_sell FROM vol WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY close_time ROWS BETWEEN 287 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ) SELECT close_time AS time, COALESCE((total_vol - avg_vol) / std_vol, 0) AS volume_zscore, COALESCE((buy_vol - avg_buy) / std_buy, 0) AS buy_vol_zscore, COALESCE((sell_vol - avg_sell) / std_sell, 0) AS sell_vol_zscore FROM stats WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time

WITH base AS ( SELECT close_time, (2 * taker_buy_base_volume - volume)::double precision AS net_flow, CASE WHEN volume > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / volume * 100)::double precision ELSE NULL END AS buy_share_pct, CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END AS ratio, LAG(CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END) OVER (ORDER BY close_time) AS prev_ratio FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' ) SELECT close_time AS time, net_flow, SUM(net_flow) OVER (ORDER BY close_time ROWS BETWEEN 23 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_net_flow, buy_share_pct, CASE WHEN prev_ratio > 0 AND ratio > 0 THEN LN(ratio / prev_ratio) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS buy_sell_log_change FROM base WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time
